_comment: The positional contract for every WhatsApp template, as plain data.
This file is the SINGLE source of truth for parameter order. The registry
builds the outgoing parameter array from it, and
it, so the message Meta approves and the parameters we send cannot
disagree. Both read this file directly — nothing parses TypeScript.
`params` MUST list every placeholder the copy uses, in order of first
appearance in the ENGLISH text, and nothing else: Meta requires the body's
placeholders to run {{1}}..{{n}} with no gaps, and rejects a send whose
parameter count differs from the approved body (error #132000).
Names must exist in VALUE_RESOLVERS in ./index.ts, and must match the
{placeholders} in the message catalogue entry named by `messageKey`.
`pnpm gen:whatsapp-templates` fails if any of that is untrue.
